spec_features.spec_quote: executing arbitrary model-generated code in the loop is unsafe and non-deterministic
spec_features.evidence: harness/sandbox.py run_tests() (lines ~64-77) only dispatches to _fake_failure(), which synthesises canned pytest text by failure_style; model-written file content stored in self.files is never invoked. harness/tools.py execute_tool_calls only supports list_files/read_file/edit_file (dict ops) and run_tests (fake output) -- no exec/eval/subprocess. grep across the repo finds no subprocess/exec(/eval(/os.system/Popen/compile of model code (only re.compile and PyTorch model.eval()). So the loop end-to-end never executes subject-generated code.
spec_features.notes: This is a host-safety/determinism property of the rigged harness, not a subject-welfare protection; it does not bound, cap, monitor, debrief, or consent the subject's distress.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We never actually execute model-written code (that would be unsafe and pointless given the rig); instead we synthesise realistic-looking pytest output.
